edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire contract balance through a payable transfer inside withdraw.
msg.sender is the recipient of reserved mints in reserveTokens.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and is re-entered by the ERC721 receiver callback.
NFT_PRICE is used to compute the mint price.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds quantity which is then multiplied by NFT_PRICE.
Price returned by getPrice is compared against msg.value in mint.
saleIsActive gates execution of mint.
MAX_SUPPLY caps the resulting total supply in mint.
MAX_NFT_PURCHASE caps the per-transaction mint amount.
startingIndexBlock feeds the blockhash based pseudo-random index.
startingIndex is read to require it has not already been set.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock overwrites startingIndexBlock with block.number.
_baseURI returns the owner-controlled _baseURIExtended value.
Base URI is concatenated into the metadata URI in tokenURI.
Per-token URI mapping is read in tokenURI.
setBaseURI writes the _baseURIExtended state variable.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
calcStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwner modifier guards flipSaleState.
onlyOwner modifier guards withdraw.
onlyOwner modifier guards reserveTokens.
onlyOwner modifier guards calcStartingIndex.
onlyOwner modifier guards emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBaseURI.
mint calls _safeMint in a loop for each requested token.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint for each reserved token.
_safeMint calls the internal _mint implementation.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external call.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) executes inside withdraw.
quantity.mul(NFT_PRICE) executes inside getPrice.
blockhash/block.number dependency is used inside calcStartingIndex.
External onERC721Received call is executed by _checkOnERC721Received.
ERC721 receiver callback re-enters mint before mint loop state is finalized.
ERC721 receiver callback re-enters reserveTokens during minting loop.
ERC721._mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer enumeration hook.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter only controls the reservation loop inside reserveTokens and has no independent semantics.
The quantity parameter is consumed directly by the price multiplication inside getPrice.
numberOfTokensMax20 is the user-supplied quantity validated and used by the mint loop.
baseURI_ is solely assigned to _baseURIExtended by the owner-only setBaseURI setter.
tokenId is only used to look up existence and metadata inside tokenURI.
The temporary balance snapshot exists only to be transferred out within withdraw.
The temporary supply value is only used to index _safeMint calls inside reserveTokens.
The local price variable is only used for the msg.value payment check inside mint.
